en.headline: Firefighters extinguish battery fire in Tuen Mun truck under bridge
en.dek: A medium goods vehicle carrying batteries caught fire on Chun Wan Road beneath the Qing Tian Road flyover at about 6:13pm; the blaze was out by 6:36pm with no injuries reported.
body: Firefighters extinguished a fire in a medium goods vehicle in Tuen Mun on Saturday evening after batteries in the cargo compartment ignited. The incident occurred at about 6:13pm as the truck travelled along Chun Wan Road towards Kin Sang, under the Qing Tian Road flyover.

Thick black smoke poured from the rear of the cargo bay, covering the road beneath the pedestrian bridge. Fire crews arrived and brought the blaze under control by 6:36pm. No one was injured. The driver was able to leave the vehicle. The Transport Department said some lanes at the junction of Qing Tian Road and Chun Wan Road were closed, causing congestion.
The cause of the fire remains under investigation. Police and fire services continued enquiries at the scene after the blaze was extinguished.

zh.headline: 屯門貨車貨斗電池起火 消防撲熄無人受傷
zh.dek: 一輚中型貨車傍晚約6時13分在震環路青田路橋底往建生方向行駛時，貨斗內電池突然起火，消防於6時36分將火救熄，無人受傷。
body: 屯門星期六傍晚發生貨車火警。一輚中型貨車沿震環路往建生方向行駛，途至青田路橋底時，貨斗內疑有電池突然起火，大量黑煙湧出，籠罩行人天橋下方道路。
消防接報趕至灌救，於晚上6時36分將火撲熄。事件中無人受傷，司機及時離開車輚。運輸署表示，因車輚著火，青田路和震環路交界部分行車線封閉，現場交通繁忙。
起火原因仍有待調查。消防及警方在火勢受控後繼續在場跟進。
